description: Accept, counter or decline an open offer on one of the seller's own listings. Amounts are in the same terms as the offer: the buyer-facing price. IMPORTANT consequences: accepting sets the listing's public price to the offer amount, and a counter becomes the listing's new public price for every buyer, not only this one. Requires confirmed: true after the seller agrees.

confirmed.description: false: nothing changes, and the result says what would. true: do it, once the seller has agreed.

counter_usd.description: Required for a counter. Buyer-facing price in US dollars.
